svg.aria-label: Left: relative error of summing up to 65536 FP16 values; a running FP16 sum stalls and the error climbs to about 0.94, a pairwise FP16 tree stays near 1e-4, an FP32 accumulator stays near 1e-7. Right: histogram of a million-element FP32 sum when 1024 block partials are added in random order, spread over many ulps, while a fixed order always gives one value
